mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 4% in the month prior to the decision is associated with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to tightened financing conditions affecting corporate investment.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% in the preceding month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are non-negative in >60% of FEDFUNDS >4% trigger events, or the 5-day moving average of 10-y yield does not diverge similarly.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment (UNRATE) below 5.5% in the month before the decision is associated with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates a potential economic recovery.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 5.5% in the prior month
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative in >70% of UNRATE <5.5% events, or pay growth (PAYEMS) does not rise concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in home sales (HOUST) exceeding 2% from the prior month predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it signals resilient consumer demand.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in >50% of HOUST >2% events, or GDP (not in catalog) growth is flat.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) of more than 5% from the prior month triggers a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as it indicates weakening manufacturing demand.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are non-negative in >80% of INDPRO < -5% events.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of declining consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL < previous month) predict a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as markets anticipate a Fed pause.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL decreases for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in >70% of CPIAUCSL double-decline events.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in job openings (PAYEMS) above 200,000 in a month predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as labor market loosening supports economic expansion.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative in >75% of PAYEMS >200k events, or unemployment (UNRATE) does not fall.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in retail sales (HOUST) and manufacturing activity (INDPRO) each above 1% in the prior month produce a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return through synergistic demand expansion.
candidate_trigger: both HOUST monthly change > +1% and INDPRO monthly change > +1%
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not statistically positive in >50% of such joint events (Granger causality fails).

mechanism_narrative: A regime shift to deflationary expectations (CPIAUCSL < 195 for two consecutive months) combined with rising risk aversion (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) predicts a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return via credit tightening and weak demand.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL < 195 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5% in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day returns are positive in >60% of such events, or FEDFUNDS drops below 4.5% in the following quarter.
